decision_points.question: At what reference date is a player's age computed?
decision_points.why_rival: each pins age to a different point in time (mid-season, end-of-season, run date); an analyst computes age once

decision_points.question: How is the raw birthday string parsed into a date?
decision_points.why_rival: single standalone choice about date-string interpretation

decision_points.question: How is the uncertainty (confidence interval / standard error) for the exposure effect computed?
decision_points.why_rival: percentile bootstrap, parametric bootstrap of the exposure coefficient, and Wald normal approximation are alternative inference procedures for the same estimate; none co-occur

decision_points.question: What model/estimator specifies the primary confound-adjusted effect?
decision_points.why_rival: HC1 logistic, g-computation, referee random intercept, cluster-robust logistic, and OLS-with-referee-FE are alternative primary estimation strategies for one effect; none co-occur

decision_points.question: Are goalkeepers included in the analysis sample?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice about goalkeeper inclusion

decision_points.question: How is player position coded/grouped as a covariate?
decision_points.why_rival: four-category collapse, unspecified factor, seven-plus-Other, and generic role buckets are rival grouping schemes; an analyst adopts one and none co-occur

decision_points.question: How is inter-rater agreement between the two skin-tone raters assessed?
decision_points.why_rival: a single agreement diagnostic versus correlation-plus-exact-match are alternative ways to report rater agreement; they do not co-occur

decision_points.question: How is the continuous skin-tone rating operationalized into the exposure variable for modeling?
decision_points.why_rival: drop-middle dichotomization, multi-threshold sweep, extreme-groups cutpoints, binary dark_skin, full-sample binary, and categorical tonecode are mutually exclusive codings of the exposure; none co-occur

decision_points.question: What rule determines the study's overall conclusion?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice of the p<0.05 verdict rule

decision_points.question: Are model predictors mean-centered before fitting?
decision_points.why_rival: single centering choice

decision_points.question: How are covariates selected for the model?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice of backward drop1 elimination

decision_points.question: How is complete-case/listwise deletion applied, and over which variable set?
decision_points.why_rival: both are listwise deletion differing only in the variable set deleted over; an analyst applies one such rule and they do not co-occur

decision_points.question: How are dyads with too few shared games excluded from the sample?
decision_points.why_rival: single minimum-shared-games exclusion threshold

decision_points.question: How is league/country entered into the adjusted model?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice of one-hot league encoding with a held-out reference

decision_points.question: Where do the standard errors in the sensitivity forest plot come from?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice to substitute placeholder SEs rather than model-derived ones

decision_points.question: How is the effect-size magnitude reported and categorized?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice of Cohen's h bucketed into categories

decision_points.question: How are degenerate bootstrap resamples handled?
decision_points.why_rival: single rule discarding resamples with too few dyads in a group

decision_points.question: What minimum sample size per exposure group is required before a threshold's result is reported?
decision_points.why_rival: single per-exposure-group reporting-sufficiency threshold

decision_points.question: What minimum data is required before a league's stratified effect is reported?
decision_points.why_rival: single league-level reporting-sufficiency threshold

decision_points.question: Is an unadjusted, league-stratified dark-vs-light risk difference computed?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice to run the league-stratified unadjusted analysis

decision_points.question: Which output statistics and diagnostics are included in the report?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice over the reported-output set

decision_points.question: How is the exposure term's statistical significance test reported?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice to report the Wald z/p on the log-odds scale

decision_points.question: Which positions are shown in the position bar chart?
decision_points.why_rival: single display choice restricting the chart to four core positions

decision_points.question: Is a secondary robustness logistic (odds-ratio) model reported alongside the primary analysis?
decision_points.why_rival: single choice to add a robustness logistic model; it coexists with the primary spec rather than replacing it

decision_points.question: How are reported exclusion/sample counts sourced — computed from data or hardcoded literals?
decision_points.why_rival: all three are the same reporting choice to hardcode counts rather than compute them, differing only in which counts; they do not co-occur
